sources.roughness_m: USGS GMTED2010 (std dev, ~230 m scale; Earth only, not used for scoring)
sources.lst_day_c: NASA MODIS MOD11A2 v061 (Terra ~10:30 overpass, 2023 mean)
sources.lst_night_c: NASA MODIS MOD11A2 v061 (Terra ~22:30 overpass, 2023 mean)
sources.albedo: NASA MODIS MCD43A3 v061 (white-sky shortwave, 2023 mean)
sources.ndvi: NASA MODIS MOD13A2 v061, 2023 annual MAXIMUM (growing-season peak)
sources.relief_55km_m: Computed by TwinWorlds: std dev of 0.05 deg elevation within each 0.5 deg cell
sources.antarctica: South of 56 S: NOAA ETOPO1 terrain (to 85 S); NDVI set to 0 where MODIS has no coverage
sources.greenland: Greenland ice sheet cells removed: GMTED2010 has no elevation there (they appeared as 0 m, perfectly flat). To restore: re-export with ETOPO1 ice surface, as done for Antarctica
